target.title: fix(slack): respect group DM sender allowlists [AI]
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Slack group-DM messages did not consistently honor sender access settings when the bot was present.

## Why This Change Was Made

Slack MPDM ingress now uses explicit Slack user IDs from the configured sender list for group-DM message/command and system/interactive paths. The change keeps normal channel user allowlists and 1:1 DM pairing behavior on their existing paths.

AI-assisted.

## User Impact

Operators using Slack group DMs can expect sender access settings to apply consistently before agent runs or interactive actions are accepted. Existing 1:1 DM behavior and regular channel sender allowlists continue to work as before.

Compatibility note: Slack group DMs / MPDMs now expect senders to be listed as explicit stable Slack user IDs in `channels.slack.allowFrom`. Existing setups that relied on wildcard entries, pairing approvals, display-name matching, or channel-member fallback may need to add explicit Slack user IDs before MPDM senders are accepted. Regular channels, private channels, and 1:1 DMs keep their existing authorization paths.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check`
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write --threads=1 extensions/slack/src/monitor/auth.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/message-handler/prepare.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/auth.test.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/message-handler/prepare.test.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/events/interactions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/slack/src/monitor/auth.test.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/message-handler/prepare.test.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/events/interactions.test.ts` (208 tests passed)
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write --threads=1 extensions/slack/src/monitor/slash.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/slash.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/slack/src/monitor/slash.test.ts` (41 tests passed)

Focused local validation passed; CI will provide broader repository coverage.

Live Slack proof was not run from this local checkout. A maintainer-run Mantis bot or other live Slack setup may be needed to generate the requested redacted MPDM allowlisted-acceptance and non-allowlisted-rejection evidence.
